core_competencies.name: Risk identification
core_competencies.description: Identifies risk type, severity, controls, evidence, and impacted stakeholders.

core_competencies.name: Escalation judgment
core_competencies.description: Owns issues and escalates with facts, urgency, and practical recommendations.

core_competencies.name: Control improvement
core_competencies.description: Improves processes, monitoring, documentation, or governance rather than only flagging problems.

core_competencies.name: Ethical judgment
core_competencies.description: Protects customers, clients, the institution, and regulatory obligations.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Classifies risk and explains severity and evidence.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Uses generic concern language with no risk analysis.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What type of risk is this and how severe is it?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Raises issues early through the right channel with documentation.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Hides or delays issues to avoid friction.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: Who needs to know and when?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Proposes control, process, training, or monitoring improvements.
Balances speed, customer impact, compliance, and operational practicality.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Treats risk as either nothing or a total stop without judgment.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What safe path keeps the business moving?
